sessions.phase_label: Video brief, translation agreement, and contract setup
Initial delivery, review, and revision instructions

requirements.title: UGC Video Production
requirements.definition: Produce a UGC-style video featuring the freelancer as the on-camera performer.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers existence of the requested UGC video deliverable only; language, script adherence, performance directions, setting, duration, and delivery criteria remain independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Strict Script Phrase Adherence
requirements.definition: Perform the supplied script closely and include every required phrase in the recorded video.
requirements.boundary_note: Script completeness can fail and require a reshoot even when the video uses Arabic MSA, so it remains separate from the language Requirement.

requirements.title: Video Delivery Channel
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed video by posting the video file or its Google Drive link in the project chat.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers where and how the video is sent; whether a posted link can actually be opened is independently testable under delivery-link accessibility.

requirements.title: Delivery Link Accessibility
requirements.definition: Ensure that any video-delivery link is functional and viewable by the client without restricted access.
requirements.boundary_note: Link permissions can fail or be fixed without changing the selected delivery channel, giving accessibility its own failure and verification trajectory.

requirements.title: Video Duration Limit
requirements.definition: Constraint governing the permissible length and maximum duration of the completed UGC video.
